uplink.description: Weather group (dataId 0x01): temperature, humidity, light, UV, wind
uplink._note: Synthetic SenseCAP S2100 telemetry frame (dataId 0x01); expected.data via the ported upstream decoder (oracle). 4097->air.temperature, 4098->air.relativeHumidity, 4099->air.lightIntensity, 4105->wind.speed; UV index (4190) as the extra `uvIndex`, matching the sensecaps2120-8-in-1 sibling.

uplink.description: Weather group (dataId 0x02): wind direction, rainfall, barometric pressure
uplink._note: Synthetic SenseCAP S2100 frame (dataId 0x02). 4104->wind.direction (a vocabulary key: the sibling sensecaps2120-8-in-1 decodes it there too, so this device must not hide it in a `windDirectionSensor` extra), 4113->rain.intensity; barometric pressure (Pa) /100 -> air.pressure (hPa). Union with the 0x01 frame covers weather-station. Not rain-gauge: 4113 is an hourly intensity, not a cumulative depth.
